title: Ukraine to restart strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zelensky says
description: The Ukrainian president says a three-day pause is over after fresh Russian attacks and US attempts to pressure Kyiv.

title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
description: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".

title: UK economy sees surprise growth in August ahead of Healey's first Budget
description: The uptick helped the economy grow by 0.7% over the three months to August, official figures show.

title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
description: Reform says all of those people filmed by ITV are under investigation having resigned or been suspended.

title: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings without public outcome, BBC Verify finds
description: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.

title: White House defends new press secretary after questions about her legal credentials
description: Katie Zacharia does not appear to be registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.

title: PM launches brain cancer review after meeting 'inspirational' patient
description: The Scottish athlete, who has inoperable brain tumours, previously made a tearful plea for more investment in brain cancer research on BBC Breakfast.

title: UK temperatures to rise to 23C before autumn chill sets in
description: Warm air will bring unseasonable warmth to the south and east of the UK on Thursday but chillier conditions are set to spread to all areas by the weekend.

title: What's going on between Kelly Clarkson and a Brooklyn store bird?
description: The Since U Been Gone singer claims she was "looked at as if I couldn't afford" an item in the store.
